claim_text: Known high iron stores or iron-overload disorders are reasons to avoid adding iron without specialist direction; unnecessary iron may worsen iron accumulation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent avoidable harm from inappropriate supplementation.

population.other_context: People with known high iron intake or iron-overload risk.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet discusses iron overload and adverse effects.
limitations: No dose; laboratory and clinician review required.
Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
